records.title: Jones & Associates
records.catalogSection: City standards, codes, permits, and plans
records.notes: Jones Civil client standards and studies — Open Clients, select the entity, then record every standards, drawing, plan, map, and study link. See the complete inventory in section 4 below. Treat this as a convenient publisher; confirm adoption and current status with the public entity.

records.title: Utah Code index
records.catalogSection: City standards, codes, permits, and plans
records.notes: Utah statutes — Search by title/chapter or keyword. Important starting points include Title 10 (municipalities), Title 15A (construction and fire codes), Title 17/17B/17D (counties and districts), Title 19 (environmental quality), Title 63G Chapter 6a (procurement), Title 63G Chapter 2 (GRAMA), Title 72 (transportation), and Title 73 (water). Save the effective-date version applicable to the project. | State construction-code adoption and amendments — In the code index select Title 15A. Identify the code edition effective on the permit-application date, then check statewide and authorized local amendments. Do not infer the edition from a city PDF alone.

records.title: Utah DOPL Uniform Building Codes laws and rules
records.catalogSection: City standards, codes, permits, and plans
records.notes: State construction-code adoption and amendments — In the code index select Title 15A. Identify the code edition effective on the permit-application date, then check statewide and authorized local amendments. Do not infer the edition from a city PDF alone.

records.title: Utah Public Notice Website
records.catalogSection: City standards, codes, permits, and plans
records.notes: Public meetings, adopted plans, budgets, minutes, and ordinances — Select Government Type, then the entity and public body. Search agendas and attachments for adoption resolutions, capital plans, impact-fee studies, budgets, and minutes.

records.title: Utah Government Records Access/GRAMA
records.catalogSection: City standards, codes, permits, and plans
records.notes: Records not published online — Send the request to the entity that maintains the record. Ask specifically for bid tabs, executed contracts, change orders, geotechnical reports, inspection records, or asset plans; provide project name, date range, and contract number. Do not request protected critical-infrastructure details for public AI storage.

records.title: UDOT Standard Specifications and Standard Drawings
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: UDOT specifications and standard drawings — Choose the edition named by the contract; collect the base book, drawing book, revision information, and every applicable special provision.

records.title: UDOT Design
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: UDOT roadway, survey, CADD, drainage, and cost guidance — Open the discipline page, capture the current manual and all effective revision memoranda, then compare their effective dates with the project's advertisement/design dates.

records.title: UDOT Roadway Design
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: UDOT roadway, survey, CADD, drainage, and cost guidance — Open the discipline page, capture the current manual and all effective revision memoranda, then compare their effective dates with the project's advertisement/design dates.

records.title: UDOT Structures and Geotechnical Guidance
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: Structures and geotechnical requirements — Collect the current manual, working standards, checklists, revision log, and project-specific special provisions.

records.title: Utah DDW laws and rules, R309
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: Drinking-water design and operation rules — For facility design, inspect the R309-500 series and source-protection R309-600 series; also capture plan-review, operating-permit, sizing, and capacity requirements applicable to the project.

records.title: Utah DWQ laws and rules, R317
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: Wastewater, stormwater, and groundwater-quality rules — Search Title R317 for collection systems, treatment, UPDES, stormwater, groundwater protection, and sewer-management requirements.

records.title: FHWA MUTCD, current edition
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: Traffic-control devices — Use the edition and state adoption applicable to the project. Preserve the PDF and revision/effective date, plus any UDOT supplement or contract special provision.

records.title: 2010 ADA Standards
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: Accessibility — Classify the facility (building/site, pedestrian right-of-way, or transit stop), then identify the enforceable agency standard and any stricter municipal/contract requirement. Do not treat all Access Board guidance as automatically enforceable in every context.

records.title: Public Right-of-Way Accessibility Guidelines
records.catalogSection: Standards and design criteria
records.notes: Accessibility — Classify the facility (building/site, pedestrian right-of-way, or transit stop), then identify the enforceable agency standard and any stricter municipal/contract requirement. Do not treat all Access Board guidance as automatically enforceable in every context.

records.title: Utah SGID documentation and index
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Statewide GIS catalog — Search the SGID index by dataset name or category. Use the linked steward as the authority. Download from SGID on ArcGIS or connect to Open SGID for repeatable queries. Capture steward, last update, coordinate system, and service URL. | Morgan County geography — Search SGID for Morgan County parcels, boundaries, roads, elevation, and imagery, then follow the steward link. Confirm zoning, plats, and survey data through Morgan County/Morgan City official records.

records.title: Atlas Utah
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Address-based map exploration — Search street address and city/ZIP, click the location, and use the returned jurisdiction and map layers as a discovery aid. Verify boundaries against recorder/survey records.

records.title: UGRC Utah Parcels
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Parcels — Select the county's download or feature service. Record PARCEL_ID, update date, source county, and disclaimer. Parcel GIS is not a legal boundary or title record.

records.title: SGID data categories
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Elevation, contours, imagery, hydrology, boundaries, and land ownership — Define a project-area polygon, choose the relevant layers/resolution, and save source metadata. State the horizontal datum, vertical datum, units, and resolution.

records.title: USGS National Map Downloader
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Elevation, contours, imagery, hydrology, boundaries, and land ownership — Define a project-area polygon, choose the relevant layers/resolution, and save source metadata. State the horizontal datum, vertical datum, units, and resolution.

records.title: Box Elder County Web Maps & Apps
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Box Elder County parcels, roads, boundaries, zoning, and surveys — Open the main interactive map; search an address or parcel number; enable cadastral, planning, road, FEMA, and survey layers. Use recorder documents for legal verification.

records.title: Cache County GIS
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Cache County parcels, zoning, floodplain, survey, canals, and downloads — Choose the parcel/zoning, floodplain, survey/section corner, canal, or drainage viewer. Download available datasets from the GIS downloads page. City zoning must be confirmed with the city.

records.title: interactive maps
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Cache County parcels, zoning, floodplain, survey, canals, and downloads — Choose the parcel/zoning, floodplain, survey/section corner, canal, or drainage viewer. Download available datasets from the GIS downloads page. City zoning must be confirmed with the city.

records.title: Davis County Property Search
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Davis County parcels — Search address or parcel, export the result needed for screening, and verify legal descriptions/ownership through recorder records.

records.title: Utah County GIS Maps
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Utah County parcels, zoning, hazards, surveys, roads, and annexations — Use the specific application for hazards, parcels, zoning, surveys, roads, or annexation plats. Vineyard projects should also be checked against Vineyard City's official zoning and engineering pages.

records.title: Weber County GIS
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Weber County parcels, city zoning, geologic/flood layers, utilities, and survey monuments — In Geo Gizmo, search address/parcel and enable the relevant engineering, geologic, FEMA, zoning, and utility layers. Treat map output as preliminary; verify with the department and recorded survey.

records.title: Survey & Monument Map
records.catalogSection: Geography, parcels, terrain, and survey control
records.notes: Weber County parcels, city zoning, geologic/flood layers, utilities, and survey monuments — In Geo Gizmo, search address/parcel and enable the relevant engineering, geologic, FEMA, zoning, and utility layers. Treat map output as preliminary; verify with the department and recorded survey.

records.title: Utah Geological Survey hazards
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Faults, liquefaction, landslides, shallow groundwater, problem soils, debris flow, and other geologic hazards — Search or zoom to the project address/coordinates and enable each relevant hazard layer. Save the map/report citation and scale. A portal hit is a screening flag, not a substitute for site-specific engineering geology or geotechnical investigation.

records.title: UGS Geologic Hazards Portal
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Faults, liquefaction, landslides, shallow groundwater, problem soils, debris flow, and other geologic hazards — Search or zoom to the project address/coordinates and enable each relevant hazard layer. Save the map/report citation and scale. A portal hit is a screening flag, not a substitute for site-specific engineering geology or geotechnical investigation.

records.title: UGS Earthquake Hazards
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Earthquake-specific information — Review fault rupture, ground shaking, liquefaction, tectonic subsidence, and earthquake-induced landslide resources. Use the linked map/publication appropriate to the city.

records.title: FEMA Map Service Center
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Flood maps and flood-insurance studies — Search the project address, obtain the effective FIRM panel and FIS, then inspect preliminary products and Letters of Map Change. For GIS, download NFHL data or use FEMA's official service. Record panel number, effective date, zone, BFE, and LOMC identifiers.

records.title: Utah Flood Hazards mapping guidance
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Flood maps and flood-insurance studies — Search the project address, obtain the effective FIRM panel and FIS, then inspect preliminary products and Letters of Map Change. For GIS, download NFHL data or use FEMA's official service. Record panel number, effective date, zone, BFE, and LOMC identifiers.

records.title: Utah Wildfire Risk
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Wildfire — Open UWRAP, zoom to the project, and capture hazard/risk layers. Check municipal WUI ordinances and the currently adopted Utah WUI provisions separately.

records.title: FEMA Resilience Analysis and Planning Tool
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Multi-hazard context — Search the city/county and enable National Risk Index layers. Use for regional screening, not parcel-level engineering design.

records.title: NOAA Climate Data Online
records.catalogSection: Earthquake and other natural hazards
records.notes: Weather and climate records — Search by city, county, ZIP, station, or map. Select dataset, date range, and nearest representative stations; download CSV and preserve station metadata.

records.title: Utah Division of Water Rights groundwater
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Groundwater management, models, and trends — Choose the relevant basin/management area, then capture the management plan, trend viewer result, model files, and publication dates.

records.title: Utah Well Log Search
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Well logs and observed water levels — Search by NAD83 UTM coordinates/radius or township-range-section. Extract well date, ground elevation if present, total depth, lithology, static water level, pumping level, and measurement date. Do not call a single historic reading the current water table.

records.title: USGS NWIS Mapper
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Independent groundwater measurements — Search address/place, enable active and inactive groundwater sites, open nearby sites, and download measurements/annual reports. Document site distance and period of record.

records.title: Utah Water Right Records
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Water rights and points of diversion — Search by water-right number, name/source, point of diversion, place of use, or map. Water rights indicate legal diversion/use records—not groundwater elevation or guaranteed supply.

records.title: Utah Division of Drinking Water
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Public drinking-water systems, sources, source-protection zones, and compliance context — Use Which water system serves me? or the map's Drinking Water layers. Confirm sensitive infrastructure restrictions before storing detailed asset locations.

records.title: DEQ Environmental Interactive Map
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Public drinking-water systems, sources, source-protection zones, and compliance context — Use Which water system serves me? or the map's Drinking Water layers. Confirm sensitive infrastructure restrictions before storing detailed asset locations. | Utah regulated sites, contamination, permits, drinking-water, waste, air, and remediation — Search address or draw a project-area polygon; enable division-specific layers; inspect results and download GIS/table data where offered. Follow each record to the program database for current status.

records.title: Blue Stakes of Utah 811
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Utility field locations — Use for a lawful locate request before excavation. It is not a complete GIS inventory and should not be scraped into a public AI repository. Obtain owner-approved record drawings through the city/utility when authorized.

records.title: USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey
records.catalogSection: Groundwater, soils, water resources, and utilities
records.notes: Soils and engineering interpretations — Start WSS, search address or draw an Area of Interest, then open Soil Data Explorer → Soil Properties and Qualities/Engineering. Export the soil map/report and SSURGO data. Use for screening; confirm design conditions by geotechnical investigation.

records.title: Utah DWQ databases and information
records.catalogSection: Environmental and cultural resources
records.notes: Surface-water assessments, monitoring, UPDES, and groundwater permits — Use AWQMS for monitoring data, the Water Quality Assessment Map for uses/impairment, and the DEQ map/EPA ECHO for permits. Export selected features and preserve the Integrated Report cycle.

records.title: USFWS Wetlands Mapper
records.catalogSection: Environmental and cultural resources
records.notes: Wetlands — Search the project and download NWI data. NWI is biological inventory screening and does not establish jurisdiction; coordinate with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers where waters may be affected.

records.title: USFWS IPaC
records.catalogSection: Environmental and cultural resources
records.notes: Listed species and critical habitat — Define the exact project polygon, create a project, request the official species list, and preserve the dated output. Login may be required for an official project record.

records.title: EPA ECHO
records.catalogSection: Environmental and cultural resources
records.notes: Environmental permit/compliance history — Search by facility name, address, or map; open the facility report and distinguish active, resolved, and alleged violations. Confirm identity before associating records with a site or contractor.

records.title: Utah SHPO records
records.catalogSection: Environmental and cultural resources
records.notes: Historic buildings and archaeological records — Use the public Hub for historic buildings. Archaeological Sego/UDAM access requires authorization; request a Class I search, table query, or GIS data cut as appropriate. Do not expose restricted site locations.

records.title: compliance resources
records.catalogSection: Environmental and cultural resources
records.notes: Historic buildings and archaeological records — Use the public Hub for historic buildings. Archaeological Sego/UDAM access requires authorization; request a Class I search, table query, or GIS data cut as appropriate. Do not expose restricted site locations.

records.title: UDOT Traffic Data
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Traffic counts, VMT, operations, safety, projects, and planning — Follow Traffic Statistics for AADT/VMT; use the planning page to identify the applicable statewide or MPO model; capture base year, forecast year, model version, and roadway ownership.

records.title: UDOT Planning Information
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Traffic counts, VMT, operations, safety, projects, and planning — Follow Traffic Statistics for AADT/VMT; use the planning page to identify the applicable statewide or MPO model; capture base year, forecast year, model version, and roadway ownership.

records.title: UDOT Traffic
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Live conditions, cameras, events, weather, and API — Use the live map for current context. Use the API only for transient operational data and store observation timestamps; a developer key is required for most API calls.

records.title: UDOT Traffic API documentation
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Live conditions, cameras, events, weather, and API — Use the live map for current context. Use the API only for transient operational data and store observation timestamps; a developer key is required for most API calls.

records.title: UDOT Traffic and Safety
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Crash data — Follow Crash Mapping or request authorized Numetric access when the project qualifies. Normalize by location, date range, severity, and roadway exposure before comparison.

records.title: WFRC Models and Forecasting
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Wasatch Front and Morgan/Box Elder regional forecasts — Use the current official model/data portal for population, employment, TAZ, traffic volumes, RTP, and TIP. Record model version and amendment.

records.title: MAG Models and Tools
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Utah County/Vineyard regional forecasts — Download official model outputs for Utah County and record scenario, model version, forecast year, and RTP amendment.

records.title: Cache MPO Maps & Data
records.catalogSection: Transportation and growth
records.notes: Cache County/Wellsville transportation data — Use traffic volumes, models/forecasts, and performance measures; record count year and forecast assumptions.

records.title: Utah Code index
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Utah procurement law — Select Title 63G → Chapter 6a, Utah Procurement Code. Save the version effective on the solicitation date and identify whether/how the local procurement unit adopted or is governed by it. Also ingest the city's procurement ordinance and policy.

records.title: Utah Division of Purchasing/U3P
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Open solicitations and statewide contracts — Select View Current Solicitations or statewide-contract search. For each event, collect the original solicitation, all addenda/Q&A, plan-holder requirements, award notice, and final contract. Cities may also use their own portal.

records.title: Jones Current Projects
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Jones Civil project solicitations — Open each project page. Collect plan-holder list, preview manual, addenda, supplemental documents, and bid tabulation. Follow the site's required document-obtaining process; previews state they are for bidding only and not for construction.

records.title: Utah Division of Corporations
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Utah entity registration — Select Business Entity Search, search exact legal name and aliases, and record status, entity number, type, and retrieval date.

records.title: Utah DOPL
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Professional/contractor licenses and discipline — Use Verify a License for the firm and named professionals; record license number, classification, status, expiration, and retrieval date. Search disciplinary actions separately.

records.title: disciplinary actions
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Professional/contractor licenses and discipline — Use Verify a License for the firm and named professionals; record license number, classification, status, expiration, and retrieval date. Search disciplinary actions separately.

records.title: SAM.gov Entity Information
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Federal entity and exclusion checks — Search exact legal name and UEI/CAGE when available. Verify potential name matches using identifiers; save the search date and evidence. Do not equate no public result with a definitive eligibility determination without following solicitation requirements.

records.title: SAM.gov Exclusions
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Federal entity and exclusion checks — Search exact legal name and UEI/CAGE when available. Verify potential name matches using identifiers; save the search date and evidence. Do not equate no public result with a definitive eligibility determination without following solicitation requirements.

records.title: OSHA Establishment Search
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Safety history — Search name variants and Utah project locations; inspect each activity/inspection, status, and final citation. Do not score a vendor solely on raw citation count without exposure, final disposition, timeframe, and solicitation authority.

records.title: FHWA Buy America/BABA
records.catalogSection: Procurement, contracts, vendors, cost, and performance
records.notes: Federal-funding domestic-content requirements — Determine the funding program, obligation/award dates, applicable waiver, and contract clauses. The solicitation and funding-agency requirements control.
